fxUsdZar.label: FX USD/ZAR
fxUsdZar.source: frankfurter.dev (ECB reference) 2026-10-29; cross-check exchangerate-api 16.6339 — agree within 0.04%. Higher of the two used, so the cost side is never understated.

greenFobUsdPerKg.label: Green coffee FOB, high end of our band
greenFobUsdPerKg.source: Our published Kigali FOB band $6.07-6.75/kg (studex-price-sheet/dist/index.html, "Live desk — re-verify before quoting"). TOP of band used: a floor is only a floor at worst-case cost.

greenFobBandLowUsdPerKg.label: Green coffee FOB, low end of band
greenFobBandLowUsdPerKg.source: Same source as above. Used only for the sensitivity table.

oceanFreightUsdPerKg.label: Ocean freight + insurance, origin → Durban
oceanFreightUsdPerKg.source: ASSUMPTION — $70/tonne on Kigali/Mombasa–Durban. Needs a forwarder quote.

importDutyRate.label: Import duty on green coffee
importDutyRate.source: ASSUMPTION — treated as 0% for green coffee into SA. NOT broker-confirmed. If this is wrong the whole floor moves.

portClearingZarPerKg.label: Port handling, clearing, inland to roastery

roastYield.label: Roast yield (kg roasted per kg green)
roastYield.source: ASSUMPTION — 15% weight loss on a filter roast. 1 kg green -> 0.85 kg roasted.

roastingCostZarPerKg.label: Roasting cost
roastingCostZarPerKg.source: ASSUMPTION — R38/kg roasted (energy, labour, depreciation, roast loss).

packZarPerKg.label: Packaging per kg roasted
packZarPerKg.source: ASSUMPTION — 1kg valve bag + label R11; 5kg R8; 20kg/30kg R6.

targetMarginPct.label: Target gross margin used to set the floor
targetMarginPct.source: POLICY — 25%. Lower than the 30% used on the caviar desk, because a volume-tiered wholesale sheet with no headroom is not a wholesale sheet. The margin actually achieved at every published tier is printed in the internal sheet.

roundingZar.label: Published prices round to the nearest R5
roundingZar.source: POLICY — a price sheet with R396.32 on it is not a price sheet.

services.name: Sample pack — 5 x 250 g cupping set
services.credit: Fully credited against your first order of 20 kg or more.
services.costBasis: Product at list R350 (5 x 250 g across the four origins) + R85 sample packing = R435. Priced at R495 to cover the pack, and credited back so the acquisition cost is recovered on the first real order.
services.confidence: COSTED from published list prices + packing assumption

services.name: Barista training — foundations workshop
services.unit: per on-site day, up to 8 staff
services.credit: Travel outside Gauteng quoted separately, at cost.
services.costBasis: Trainer day R2,500 + travel/accommodation R1,000 + materials R750 + consumables R1,000 = R5,250. Priced at R7,500 (~30% margin). Benchmarked against SA barista schools at R1,500-3,000 per person — R938 per head here.
services.confidence: ASSUMPTION — trainer day rate not confirmed

services.name: Barista training — monthly retainer
services.credit: One on-site half-day per month, up to 6 staff. 3-month minimum: R10,500.
services.costBasis: Half-day session ~R1,800 (trainer R1,250 + travel R550). Priced at R3,500/month. The retainer is the wedge: it turns a transactional bean sale into a recurring account, and it is the one thing the office-coffee-service majors do not offer.
services.confidence: ASSUMPTION — trainer day rate not confirmed

services.name: In-room single-serve sachet
services.credit: R4.20 each at 500-999 units. R1,500 one-off print setup. Case of 1,000: R3,950.
services.costBasis: Coffee at the 30 kg tier (R240/kg) = R0.48 per 2 g sachet + sachet film, print and fill R1.20 = R1.67. Priced at R3.95. Custom-printed with the hotel brand — the hotel keeps the margin on the cup and the room sees the brand, not ours.
services.confidence: COSTED from the 30 kg tier price + packaging assumption

logistics.label: Roasting
logistics.value: Roasted to order. Dispatched within 2 business days of order.

logistics.label: Delivery
logistics.value: Free on orders over R850 in Gauteng, over R1,500 nationally. Below that R95 (Gauteng) / R135 (national).

logistics.label: Delivery time
logistics.value: 48 hours Gauteng, KZN, Cape Town. 72 hours nationally.

logistics.label: Payment
logistics.value: 30-day terms on account after the first order; card or EFT for the first order.

logistics.label: Green stock
logistics.value: Green lots land Durban on a 3-4 week cycle from FOB. Stock dates quoted per order.
